situation.title: emergent_institutional_fracture
situation.description: The European Evaluation Shield's credibility collapses further as two member states formally reject its authority to impose remediation mandates, citing lack of legal basis and transparency. This creates an open rift between national sovereignty and EU-level oversight, paralyzing enforcement of safety norms across the bloc.

situation.title: Evidence of a Bending Curve
situation.description: A major release underdelivers against its own briefing, and – the stronger signal – the price of top-tier capability falls sharply rather than staying flat, which is what happens when the frontier stops moving and last year's ceiling becomes this year's commodity. It is disputed at once, and the dispute is not resolvable from outside the laboratories.
